rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Samad is the absolute support: every contingent thing needs Him and exists through Him, while He is absolutely self-sufficient.
rows.anchor: الذات في الحضرة الواحدية بحسب اعتبار الأسماء هو السند المطلق لكل الأشياء لافتقار كل ممكن إليه وكونه به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Everything besides God exists through His existence and has no existence in itself; possibility alone does not entail existence, so nothing resembles Him.
rows.anchor: كل ما سواه موجودا بوجوده ليس بشيء في نفسه لأن الإمكان اللازم للماهية لا يقتضي الوجود فلا يجانسه ولا يماثله شيء في الوجود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He did not beget because His effects do not exist alongside Him but through Him; through Him they are, while by themselves they are nothing.
rows.anchor: معلولاته ليست موجودة معه بل به فهي به هي وبنفسها ليست شيئا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He was not begotten because His absolute self-sufficiency means He needed nothing for His existence.
rows.anchor: لصمديته المطلقة، فلم يكن محتاجا في الوجود إلى شيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one divine identity admits neither multiplicity nor division; everything other than absolute existence is pure nonexistence and cannot be His equal.
rows.anchor: هويته الأحدية غير قابلة للكثرة والانقسام ولم يمكن مقارنة الوحدة الذاتية لغيرها إذ ما عدا الوجود المطلق ليس إلا العدم المحض فلا يكافئه أحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The surah is called the Foundation because religion is founded on monotheism, indeed existence itself has monotheism as its foundation.
rows.anchor: سميت سورة الأساس، إذ أساس الدين على التوحيد بل أساس الوجود

rows.speaker: أنس عن النبي
rows.claim: Anas reports from the Prophet that the seven heavens and seven earths were founded upon this declaration; Qashani identifies this with God's self-sufficiency.
rows.anchor:
عن أنس عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قال:
" أسست السماوات السبع والأرضون السبع على قل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The report that the heavens and earth were founded on the surah expresses the meaning of God's self-sufficiency.
rows.anchor: وهو معنى صمديته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-falaq is dawn before sunrise; its Lord is the guiding name, and refuge means taking on that name and joining the Spirit of Holiness in the realm of names.
rows.anchor: ألتجىء إلى الاسم الهادي وألوذ به بالاتصاف به والاتصال بروح القدس في الحضرة الأسمائية لأن الفلق هو نور الصبح المقدم على طلوع الشمس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The dawn of the attributes precedes the dawn of the Essence, so the Lord of dawn is the guiding name.
rows.anchor: برب نور صبح تجلي الصفات الذي هو مقدمة طلوع نور الذات، ورب نور صبح الصفات هو الاسم الهادي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person seeking refuge from something seeks the divine name specific to it: the sick seek the Healer and the ignorant seek the Knowing.
rows.anchor: كل مستعيذ بربه من شر شيء فإنه يستعيذ بالاسم المخصوص بذلك الشيء كاستعاذة المريض مثلا بربه فإنه يستعيذ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The evil of creation is interpreted as being veiled by creatures and affected by them; one joined to the sacred realm and God's names influences creatures without being affected by them.
rows.anchor: من شر الاحتجاب بالخلق وتأثيرهم فيه فإن من اتصل بعالم القدس في حضرة الأسماء واتصف بصفاته تعالى أثر في كل مخلوق ولم يتأثر من أحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Creatures remain in the realm of effects and acts, whereas the spiritual traveler has risen to the attributes from which acts proceed.
rows.anchor: لأنهم في عالم الآثار ومقام الأفعال وقد ارتقى هو عن مقام الأفعال إلى مباديها من الصفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The darkening one is the dark body: its darkness enters and dominates everything, changing the heart through bodily states and temperament because the heart loves and inclines toward it.
rows.anchor: من شر الاحتجاب بالبدن المظلم إذا دخل ظلامه كل شيء واستولى وأثر بتغيرات أحواله وانحراف مزاجه في القلب لمحبة القلب له وميله إليه وانجذابه نحوه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The blowers are psychic powers such as imagination, fancy, anger, and appetite; satanic prompts weaken travelers' resolve and whispers untie it.
rows.anchor: القوى النفسانية من الوهم والتخيل والغضب والشهوة ونحوها التي تنفث في عقد عزائم السالكين بإيهانها بالدواعي الشيطانية وحلها ونكثها بالوساوس والهواجس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The envying self steals the heart's attributes and knowledge, overwhelms and veils it; this is fluctuation in the heart's spiritual station.
rows.anchor: النفس إذا حسدت تنور القلب فانتحلت صفاته ومعارفه باستراق السمع، فطغت وظهرت عليه وحجبته وذلك هو التلوين في

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the darkening one is the soul that veils the heart, while the envier is the heart appearing in the station of witnessing; the heart's presence colors that station as the soul colors the heart's.
rows.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون الغاسق هو النفس المستولية الحاجبة بظلمة صفاتها للقلب والحاسد هو القلب إذا ظهر في مقام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These three are singled out after seeking refuge from creatures generally because they cause most veiling through their close connection and attachment to the person.
rows.anchor: وتخصيص هذه الثلاثة بالاستعاذة منها بعد الاستعاذة من المخلوقات عموما إنما كان لأن أكثر الاحتجاب منها دون ما عداها من المخلوقات عموما لاتصالها به وتعلقه بها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Lord of people is the Essence with all attributes: the human is the comprehensive cosmos containing every level of existence, created and perfected by the Essence considered through all names.
rows.anchor: رب الناس هو الذات مع جميع الصفات لأن الإنسان هو الكون الجامع الحاصر لجميع مراتب الوجود ربه الذي أوجده وأفاض عليه كماله هو الذات باعتبار جميع الأسماء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's creating Adam with His two hands signifies the opposing attributes, such as gentleness and severity, beauty and majesty, encompassing all attributes.
rows.anchor: بالمتقابلين من الصفات كاللطف والقهر والجمال والجلال الشاملين لجميعها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This refuge turns to God's face after the earlier refuge in attributes; hence this surah follows the first, whose guiding name leads from the station of attributes to the Essence.
rows.anchor: تعوذ بوجهه بعدما تعوذ بصفاته ولهذا تأخرت هذه السورة عن المعوذة الأولى إذ فيها تعوذ في مقام الصفات باسمه الهادي فهداه إلى ذاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “King of people” explains the Lord: He owns their persons and affairs as they pass away in Him; in truth the King is the One, the Subduer.
rows.anchor: ثم بين رب الناس بملك الناس على أنه عطف بيان لأن الملك هو الذي يملك رقابهم وأمورهم باعتبار حال فنائهم فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse about dominion on the day of resurrection shows that the true King is the One who subdues everything through His manifestation.
rows.anchor: فالملك بالحقيقة هو الواحد القهار الذي قهر كل شيء بظهوره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “God of people” explains their subsistence after annihilation: God is the absolutely worshipped Essence with all attributes considered at the final stage.
rows.anchor: ثم عطف عليه { إله الناس } لبيان حال بقائهم بعد الفناء لأن الإله هو المعبود المطلق وذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The servant seeks refuge in the absolute presence, is annihilated in Him and appears as His kingdom, then is returned to existence for servanthood and becomes a lasting worshipper.
rows.anchor: استعاذ بجنابه المطلق ففني فيه فظهر كونه ملكا ثم رده إلى الوجود لمقام العبودية فكان معبودا دائما فتم استعاذته به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whispering requires an existent locus such as the breast; in annihilation there is no breast, whisper, or whisperer, but if egohood appears again the servant says, “I seek refuge in You from You.”
rows.anchor: لأن الوسوسة تقتضي محلا وجوديا كما قال: { الذي يوسوس في صدور الناس } ولا وجود في حال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When the worshipper appears in existence, Satan appears through the worshipper, just as Satan first existed through that presence.
rows.anchor: فلما صار معبودا بوجود العابد ظهر الشيطان بظهور العابد كما كان أولا موجودا بوجوده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Waswas means whispering but names the whisperer because his whispering is constant, as though whispering were his own nature.
rows.anchor: والوسواس اسم للوسوسة سمي به الموسوس لدوام وسوسته كأن نفسه وسواس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The refuge is sought through God, not a particular divine name, because Satan opposes the All-Merciful and takes over the comprehensive human form, appearing through every name except Allah.
rows.anchor: وإنما استعاذ منه بالإله دون بعض أسمائه كما في السورة الأولى لأن الشيطان هو الذي يقابل الرحمن ويستولي على الصورة الجمعية الإنسانية ويظهر في صور جميع الأسماء ويتمثل بها إلا بالله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The guiding, knowing, or powerful names alone cannot suffice against Satan; refuge from veiling and error is sought from the Lord of people, while refuge from misguidance was sought from the Lord of dawn.
rows.anchor: فلم تكف الاستعاذة منه بالهادي والعليم والقدير وغير ذلك فلهذا لما تعوذ من الاحتجاب والضلالة تعوذ برب الفلق وها هنا تعوذ برب الناس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet said that whoever sees him has truly seen him, for Satan cannot take his form.
rows.anchor: من رآني فقد رآني فإن الشيطان لا يتمثل بي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Khannas means one who retreats: Satan whispers only during heedlessness and withdraws whenever the servant becomes alert and remembers God.
rows.anchor: الخناس، أي: الرجاع لأنه لا يوسوس إلا مع الغفلة وكلما تنبه العبد وذكر الله خنس فالخنوس عادة له

rows.speaker: سعيد بن جبير
rows.claim: Saʿid ibn Jubayr says that when a person remembers his Lord Satan retreats and leaves, but when he is heedless Satan whispers to him.
rows.anchor: عن سعيد بن جبير: إذا ذكر الإنسان ربه خنس الشيطان وولى، وإذا غفل وسوس إليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “From jinn and people” identifies the two kinds of whisperers: an imperceptible jinn such as imagination and perceptible human misleaders.
rows.anchor: من الجنة والناس } بيان للذي يوسوس، فإن الموسوس من الشيطان جنسان: جني غير محسوس كالوهم، وإنسي محسوس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Human misleaders may appear as guides, as in the verse describing people who came from the right hand; they may also take other divine-name forms, so refuge is only complete in God.
rows.anchor: وأما في صورة غيره من صور الأسماء فلا يتم أيضا الاستعاذة منه إلا بالله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Fatiha is called the Mother of the Book because it commands servanthood and praises God's lordship; the report of prayer divided between God and servant refers to reciting it, making it the basis of subtle gifts and nearness.
rows.anchor: وتسمى هذه السورة أيضا أم الكتاب ، وأم الشيء أصله ، وإمام كل شيء مقدمه . وهذه السورة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The opening “in the name” means events appear and creatures exist through God; everything created begins from Him and returns to Him, and acts of belief, denial, recognition, and sin all occur through Him.
rows.anchor: الباء في بسم الله حرف التضمين ؛ أي بالله ظهرت الحادثات ، وبه وجدت المخلوقات ، فما من

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One explanation for saying “in the name of God” rather than “by God” is to seek blessing by mentioning the name.
rows.anchor: وقال : { بسم الله } ولم يقل بالله على وجه التبرك بذكر اسمه عند قوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another explanation distinguishes the phrase from an oath.
rows.anchor: وللفرق بين هذا وبين القسم عند الآخرين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The theologians say that the name is the named one.
rows.anchor: ولأن الاسم هو المسمى عند العلماء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The gnostics intend to clear hearts of attachments and secrets of obstacles so that the name Allah arrives to a purified heart and secret.
rows.anchor: ولاستصفاء القلوب من العلائق ولاستخلاص الأسرار عن العوائق عند أهل العرفان ، ليكون ورود قوله { الله }

rows.speaker: قوم
rows.claim: One group reads the letters bāʾ, sīn, and mīm as God's kindness to His friends, secret with intimates, and favor to those under His protection.
rows.anchor: قوم عند ذكر هذه الآية يتذكرون من الباء ( بره ) بأوليائه ومن السين سره مع أصفيائه ومن

rows.speaker: قوم
rows.claim: Another group takes the letters to signify God's freedom from evil, safety from defect, and glory in His attributes.
rows.anchor: وقوم عند سماع بسم الله تذكروا بالباء براءة الله سبحانه وتعالى من كل سوء ، وبالسين سلامته سبحانه

rows.speaker: آخرون
rows.claim: Others associate the letters with His radiance, sublimity, and dominion.
rows.anchor: وآخرون يذكرون عند الباء بهاءه ، وعند السين سناءه ، وعند الميم ملكه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Since the basmala recurs at the beginning of each surah and is established as part of it, Qushayri gives distinct, non-repeated allusions in each surah and treats this one at length here.
rows.anchor: فلما أعاد الله سبحانه وتعالى هذه الآية أعني بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم في كل سورة وثبت أنها منها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The lover finds blame for loving the beloved pleasurable; Qushayri reads the command in 15:97 as listening to what is said with praise of God.
rows.anchor: والحق سبحانه يقول ) : ^ ( ولقد نعلم أنك يضيق صدرك بما يقولون فسبح بحمد ربك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hamd is praise of the praised one by naming noble attributes and beautiful acts; the definite article denotes the whole, so every praise, whether for attribute or act, belongs to God.
rows.anchor: حقيقة الحمد الثناء على المحمود ، بذكر نعوته الجليلة وأفعاله الجميلة ، واللام ها هنا للجنس ، ومقتضاها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is praised for the manifestation of His sovereignty and thanked for the abundance of His beneficence.
rows.anchor: فله الحمد لظهور سلطانه ، وله الشكر لوفور إحسانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Praise is due to God's majesty and beauty, while thanks answer His abundant gifts and gracious favors.
rows.anchor: والحمد لله لاستحقاقه لجلاله وجماله ، والشكر لله لجزيل نواله وعزيز أفضاله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's self-praise is a perfection of His attributes and power; creatures praise Him for His beneficence, generosity, majesty, and beauty.
rows.anchor: فحمده سبحانه له هو من صفات كماله وحوله ، وحمد الخلق له على إنعامه وطوله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qushayri enumerates God's eternal existence, generosity, oneness, everlastingness, hearing, sight, decree, speech, might, mercy, and beauty as aspects of His exalted perfection.
rows.anchor: فله الوجود ( قدرة ) القديم ، وله الجود الكريم ، وله الثبوت الأحدي ، والكون الصمدي ،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The passage expresses divine unity through paired identities: His being is His essence, eternity His endlessness, decree His destiny, majesty His beauty, and command and anger are inseparable from their counterparts.
rows.anchor: رداؤه ، وعلاؤه سناؤه ، ومجده عزه ، وكونه ذاته ، وأزله أبده ، وقدمه سرمده ، وحقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Knowing that His friends long to praise Him but cannot do justice to His glory, God praises Himself in the Fatiha; hearing God's praise of Himself revives and honors their secrets.
rows.anchor: علم الحق سبحانه وتعالى شدة إرادة أوليائه بحمده وثنائه ، وعجزهم عن القيام بحق مدحه على مقتضى عزه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On hearing God's self-praise, the Prophet recognized that restraint was fitting and said he could not enumerate God's praise, for God is as He praised Himself.
rows.anchor: لما سمع حمده لنفسه ، ومدحه سبحانه لحقه ، علم النبي أن تقاصر اللسان أليق به في هذه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those at one level praise God for gifts that benefit or avert harm, but recognize only a portion of His kindness and favors.
rows.anchor: وتتفاوت طبقات الحامدين لتباينهم في أحوالهم ؛ فطائفة حمدوه على ما نالوا من إنعامه وإكرامه من نوعي صفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One group praises God for the subtle wonders disclosed to their hearts, hidden kindness in their innermost selves, and sudden inspirations of His encounters.
rows.anchor: وطائفة حمدوه على ما لاح لقلوبهم من عجائب لطائفه ، وأودع سرائرهم من مكنونات بره ، وكاشف أسرارهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another group praises Him while witnessing the eternal attributes and does not turn from majesty and generosity to count blessings; praising majesty differs from thanking for favors.
rows.anchor: وقوم حمدوه عند شهود ما كاشفهم به من صفات القدم ، ولم يردوا من ملاحظة العز والكرم إلى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A further group is consumed by divine unity: God speaks through them, from Himself and toward Himself, while outwardly they remain in differentiation and inwardly are held by the gathering of union.
rows.anchor: وقوم حمدوه مستهلكين عنهم فيما استنطقوا من عبارات تحميده ، بما اصطلم أسرارهم من حقائق توحيده ، فهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The name Lord means master; “the worlds” includes every creature, rational and inanimate, whose entities God owns and whose forms and dwellings He brings into being.
rows.anchor: الرب هو السيد ، والعالمون جميع المخلوقات ، واختصاص هذا الجمع بلفظ العالمين لاشتماله على العقلاء والجمادات فهو

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lord also means nurturer: He supports worshippers' souls, guides seekers' hearts, unifies knowers' spirits, provides for bodies, and lets spirits witness generosity.
rows.anchor: ويدل اسم الرب أيضا على تربية الخلق ، فهو مرب نفوس العابدين بالتأييد ومرب قلوب الطالبين بالتسديد ،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lord also means one who sets affairs right: He cares for ascetics, suffices worshippers, and gives knowers His ancient care, leading some to contentment, others to longing, and others to readiness for meeting Him.
rows.anchor: فهو مصلح أمور الزاهدين بجميل رعايته ، ومصلح أمور العابدين بحسن كفايته ، ومصلح أمور الواجدين بقديم عنايته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Rahman and al-Rahim derive from mercy, an eternal attribute meaning the will of blessing; as emphatic forms they do not differ for those who verify spiritual realities.
rows.anchor: اسمان مشتقان من الرحمة ، والرحمة صفة أزلية وهي إرادة النعمة وهما اسمان موضوعان للمبالغة ولا فضل بينهما

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: An alternative view makes al-Rahman more emphatic and complete; only God is called al-Rahman absolutely, while al-Rahim can describe others.
rows.anchor: وقيل الرحمن أشد مبالغة وأتم في الإفادة ، وغير الحق سبحانه لا يسمى بالرحمن على الإطلاق ، والرحيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The servant recognizes God as al-Rahman through His mercy; without that mercy no one would know Him by this name.
rows.anchor: وبرحمته عرف العبد أنه الرحمن ، ولولا رحمته لما عرف أحد أنه الرحمن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If mercy is the will of blessing or blessing itself, blessings differ in rank: some benefit bodies and outward life, others spirits and inner life.
rows.anchor: وإذا كانت الرحمة إرادة النعمة ، أو نفس النعمة كما هي عند قوم فالنعم في أنفسها مختلفة ،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On the view that distinguishes the names, al-Rahman has a specific name but broad meaning, giving everyone outward comfort, while al-Rahim has a broad name but specific meaning, giving believers inward life.
rows.anchor: وعلى طريقة من فرق بينهما فالرحمن خاص الاسم عام المعنى ، والرحيم عام الاسم خاص المعنى ؛ فلأنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The paired names are also read as outward refreshment from al-Rahman and inward illumination from al-Rahim.
rows.anchor: فالرحمن بما روح ، والرحيم بما لوح ؛ فالترويح بالمبار ، والتلويح بالأنوار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Rahman discloses His manifestation, while al-Rahim gently takes charge of the servant.
rows.anchor: والرحمن بكشف تجليه والرحيم بلطف توليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Rahman grants faith, while al-Rahim bestows recognition; another pairing assigns recognition to al-Rahman and forgiveness to al-Rahim.
rows.anchor: والرحمن بما أولى من الإيمان والرحيم بما أسدى من العرفان ، والرحمن بما أعطى من العرفان والرحيم بما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Further distinctions pair al-Rahman with granting forgiveness and al-Rahim with bestowing divine satisfaction, then pair them with veiling and the bliss of vision.
rows.anchor: بل الرحمن بما ينعم به من الغفران والرحيم بما يمن به من الرضوان ، بل الرحمن بما يكتم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Rahman enables spiritual practice, while al-Rahim brings realization; practice belongs to seekers and realized communion to those who have found.
rows.anchor: بل الرحمن بما يوفق ، والرحيم بما تحقق ، والتوفيق للمعاملات ، والتحقيق للمواصلات ، فالمعاملات للقاصدين ،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Rahman makes things for the servants through gracious care, and al-Rahim wards things off through gracious solicitude.
rows.anchor: والرحمن بما يصنع لهم والرحيم بما يدفع عنهم ؛ فالصنع بجميل الرعاية والدفع بحسن العناية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The owner is one who possesses dominion; God's dominion is His power to originate creation, and He is both King and owner.
rows.anchor: المالك من له الملك ، وملك الحق سبحانه وتعالى قدرته على الإبداع ، فالملك مبالغة من المالك وهو

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Just as none but God is divine, none but He can create from nothing; He is singular in divinity and unique in dominion.
rows.anchor: وكما لا إله إلا هو فلا قادر على الإبداع إلا هو ، فهو بإلهيته متوحد ، وبملكه متفرد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God owns worshippers' souls and turns them to His service, makes knowers' hearts noble through knowledge, and makes seekers and finders passionately devoted to Him.
rows.anchor: ملك نفوس العابدين فصرفها في خدمته ، وملك قلوب العارفين فشرفها بمعرفته ، وملك نفوس القاصدين فتيمها ،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He owns servants' bodies and treats them gently with gifts, while disclosing His majesty and beauty to the spirits of those He loves.
rows.anchor: ملك أشباح من عبده فلاطفها بنواله وأفضاله ، وملك أرواح من أحبهم ( . . . . )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He directs and supports the monotheists as He wills, never leaving them to themselves even briefly or granting them control over themselves for a year or a passing thought.
rows.anchor: ملك زمام أرباب التوحيد فصرفهم حيث شاء على ما شاء ووفقهم حيث شاء على ما شاء كما شاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's kindness makes worshippers hope in His gifts, whereas His sovereignty makes monotheists content with His abiding presence.
rows.anchor: ملك قلوب العابدين إحسانه فطمعوا في عطائه ، وملك قلوب الموحدين سلطانه فقنعوا ببقائه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Knowing that God owns them removes their choice: a servant owns nothing, has no authority, and therefore neither turns from obedience nor objects to God's decree.
rows.anchor: عرف أرباب التوحيد أنه مالكهم فسقط عنهم اختيارهم ، علموا أن العبد لا ملك له ، ومن لا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Day of Judgment is the day of recompense, resurrection, accounting, and gathering; God accepts some by grace rather than deeds and rejects others by His decree rather than their crime.
rows.anchor: ويوم الدين } . يوم الجزاء والنشر ، ويوم الحساب والحشر - الحق سبحانه وتعالى يجزي كلا بما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God keeps the seekers from settling among likenesses through the gentle gift of union and disclosure of majesty and beauty.
rows.anchor: حل بيننا وبين مساكنة الأمثال والأشكال ، بما تلاطفنا به من وجود الوصال ، وتكاشفنا به من شهود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Guidance to truth prevents reliance on the means of spiritual practice and keeps conjecture from clouding the oneness of God.
rows.anchor: أرشدنا إلى الحق لئلا نتكل على وسائط المعاملات ، ويقع على وجه التوحيد غبار الظنون وحسبان الإعلال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Guide us” asks God to remove the darkness of one's states and the shadow of one's striving so that His holiness and generosity become lights by which one finds Him.
rows.anchor: أزل عنا ظلمات أحوالنا لنستضيء بأنوار قدسك عن التفيؤ بظلال طلبنا ، وارفع عنا ظل جهدنا لنستبصر بنجوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The straight path keeps Satan's impulses, the soul's notions, inherited imitation, routine instruction, habit, fatigue, weak resolve, and greed from delaying arrival or insight.
rows.anchor: حتى لا يصحبنا قرين من نزغات الشيطان ووساوسه ، ورفيق من خطرات النفوس وهواجسها ، أو يصدنا عن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The straight path is proved by Scripture and Sunna; innovation has no authority or route upon it.
rows.anchor: الصراط المستقيم ما عليه من الكتاب والسنة دليل ، وليس للبدعة عليه سلطان ولا إليه سبيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is also the path validated by signs of monotheism, witnesses of realization, the early Muslim community, and lessons drawn from evidence.
rows.anchor: الصراط المستقيم ما شهدت بصحته دلائل التوحيد ، ونبهت عليه شواهد التحقيق ، الصراط المستقيم ما درج عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The path separates its travelers from self-interest and its seekers from claims to personal entitlement.
rows.anchor: الصراط المستقيم ما باين الحظوظ سالكه ، وفارق الحقوق قاصده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The path leads to monotheism and lets its traveler witness divine care and generosity, so effort is not mistaken for a claim that reward is owed.
rows.anchor: الصراط المستقيم ما يفضي بسالكه إلى ساحة التوحيد ، ويشهد صاحبه أثر العناية والجود ، لئلا يظنه موجب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those favored with this path are saints and the elect, whom God has annihilated from themselves and established through Himself, without hidden divine stratagems stopping them.
rows.anchor: يعني طريق من أنعمت عليهم بالهداية إلى الصراط المستقيم ، وهم الأولياء والأصفياء . ويقال طريق من (

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another description of the favored is that they fulfill God's rights without turning aside to secure their own interests.
rows.anchor: ويقال صراط من أنعمت عليهم بالقيام بحقوقك دون التعريج على استجلاب حظوظهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are also described as purified of their own traces so that they reach God through God.
rows.anchor: ويقال صراط من ( طهرتهم ) عن آثارهم حتى وصلوا إليك بك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They have been freed from Satan's snares, the soul's errors, and imagined arrival before human traces have faded.
rows.anchor: ويقال صراط من أنعمت عليهم حتى تحرروا من مكائد الشيطان ، ومغاليط النفوس ومخاييل الظنون ، وحسبانات الوصول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They rely on God, disown their own power, and witness their prior happiness in God's choice and His unity in what He decrees as pleasant or painful.
rows.anchor: ويقال صراط من أنعمت عليهم بالنظر والاستعانة بك ، والتبري من الحول والقوة ، وشهود ما سبق لهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The favored preserve proper etiquette in service and remain aware of reverent awe.
rows.anchor: ويقال صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم بحفظ الأدب في أوقات الخدمة ، واستشعار نعت الهيبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They preserve the rules of sacred law even during overpowering disclosures of spiritual realities, never exceeding knowledge or neglecting a ruling.
rows.anchor: ويقال صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم بأن حفظت عليهم آداب الشريعة وأحكامها عند غلبات ( بواده ) الحقائق حتى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The suns of their knowledge do not extinguish the lights of their scrupulousness, and they never neglect a rule of the Law.
rows.anchor: ويقال صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم حتى لم تطفئ شموس معارفهم أنوار ورعهم ولم يضيعوا شيئا من أحكام الشرع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The favored remain servants even when the power of spiritual reality appears.
rows.anchor: ويقال صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم بالعبودية عند ظهور سلطان الحقيقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those under wrath are struck by abandonment, deprivation, rejection, separation, and expulsion.
rows.anchor: المغضوب عليهم الذين صدمتهم هواجم الخذلان ، وأدركتهم مصائب الحرمان ، وركبتهم سطوة الرد ، وغلبتهم بواده الصد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are also described as humiliated and ruined, occupied with pursuing gratification while imagining they possess something; their misery has a divine secret.
rows.anchor: ويقال هم الذين لحقهم ذل الهوان ، وأصابهم سوء الخسران ، فشغلوا في الحال باجتلاب الحظوظ - وهو

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another group tasted nearness for a time, then was turned to distance and failed to reach the intimacy it desired; its effort and hope came to nothing.
rows.anchor: ويقال هم الذين أنسوا بنفحات التقريب زمانا ثم أظهر الحق سبحانه في بابهم شانا ؛ بدلوا بالوصول بعادا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those under wrath forgot divine enabling and closed their eyes to the sight of divine support.
rows.anchor: ويقال غير المغضوب عليهم بنسيان التوفيق ، والتعامي عن رؤية التأييد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who go astray fail to witness God's prior choice and the unfolding of His decrees.
rows.anchor: ولا الضالين عن شهود سابق الاختيار ، وجريان التصاريف والأقدار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those under wrath also neglect the etiquette of service and fall short in fulfilling the conditions of obedience.
rows.anchor: ويقال غير المغضوب عليهم بتضييعهم آداب الخدمة ، وتقصيرهم في أداء شروط الطاعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They can also be people cut off in the deserts of absence, scattered by worries through valleys of conjecture.
rows.anchor: ويقال غير المغضوب عليهم هم الذين تقطعوا في مفاوز الغيبة ، وتفرقت بهم الهموم في أودية وجوه الحسبان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Saying amin after the Fatiha is Sunnah and means “Lord, do and answer”; it seeks enabling for deeds and fulfillment of hopes through humble petition.
rows.anchor: ويقول العبد عند قراءة هذه السورة آمين ، والتأمين سنة ، ومعناه يا رب افعل واستجب ، وكأنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The strongest means for the needy is continual seeking of God's aid, expressed through sincere supplication and disavowal of one's own power and ability.
rows.anchor: وإن أقوى وسيلة للفقير تعلقه بدوام الاستعانة لتحققه بصدق الاستغاثة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hearing “in the name of God” illuminates a knower's heart, disperses distress, and deepens love; a believer who knows it loves it and gives up sleep and other desires for it.
rows.anchor: كلمة من عرفها وفي قلبه إيمانه أحبها من داخل الفؤاد ، وهجر في طلبها الرقاد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-ghashiya means the enveloping event, namely the Resurrection, which covers all creatures and the faces of disbelievers.
rows.anchor: الغاشية ) المجللة ، يريد بها القيامة تغشى الخلق ، تغشى وجوه الكفار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The humbled faces are lowly on that day.
rows.anchor: وجوه - إذا جاءت القيامة - خاشعة أي ذليلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nāsiba means toil and exhaustion; one transmitted interpretation says the damned are dragged on their faces.
rows.anchor: عاملة ناصبة : النصب التعب . جاء في التفسير : أنهم يجرون على وجوههم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One reading makes them workers in sins in this world and sufferers of punishment in the next.
rows.anchor: ويقال : ( عاملة ) في الدنيا بالمعاصي ، ( ناصبة ) في الآخرة بالعذاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another reading describes strenuous worldly work without sincerity, like monks' labor or the work of hypocrites.
rows.anchor: ويقال : ( ناصبة ) في الدنيا ( عاملة ) لكن من غير إخلاص كعمل الرهبان ، وفي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They remain in a fire of intense heat.
rows.anchor: تصلى نارا حامية } تلزم نارا شديدة الحر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Outward bodily obedience without the soul's realization of disclosures, the secret's witnessing lights, or sincerity and truth in the heart brings no benefit; it is merely exhausting labor.
rows.anchor: وإن اتصاف الأبدان - اليوم - بصورة الطاعات مع فقد الأرواح وجدان المكاشفات ( وفقد ) الأسرار أنوار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The spring called aniya has reached the utmost heat.
rows.anchor: تسقى من عين ءانية } . تناهى حرها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Dariʿ is a thorny Hijazi plant poisonous to animals; in Hell it chokes those who eat it, so they are given zaqqum to drink.
rows.anchor: نبت ينمو بالحجاز له شوك ، وهو سم لا تأكله الدواب ، فإذا أكلوا ذلك في النار يغصون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The blissful faces are enjoying blessing and radiance.
rows.anchor: وجوه يومئذ ناعمة } . أي : متنعمة ، ذات نعمة ونضارة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are content with their striving when they find its reward and acceptance.
rows.anchor: لسعيها راضية } . حين وجدت الثواب على سعيها ، والقبول لها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The garden is elevated in rank, station, and honor; its inhabitants' bodies occupy their ranks while their spirits converse intimately with God.
rows.anchor: جنة عالية } . عالية في درجتها ومنزلتها وشرفها . هم بأبدانهم في درجاتهم ، ولكن بأرواحهم مع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No idle speech is heard there because its people hear through God; some hear through God, some for God, and some from God.
rows.anchor: لا تسمع فيها لاغية } . لأنهم يسمعون بالله ؛ فليس فيها كلمة لغو . قوم يسمعون بالله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A prophetic report says God becomes the believer's hearing and sight.
rows.anchor: وفي الخبر : ( كنت له سمعا وبصرا فبي يسمع وبي يبصر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The singular “spring” is a generic noun referring to the many abundant and varied flowing springs in Paradise.
rows.anchor: فيها عين جارية } . أراد عيونا ؛ لأن العين اسم جنس ، والعيون الجارية هنالك كثيرة ومختلفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those whose eyes flow with tears today will have flowing springs tomorrow, and springs that gaze upon the meeting with God.
rows.anchor: ويقال : تلك العيون الجارية غدا لمن له - اليوم - عيون جارية بالبكاء ، وغدا لهم عيون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Raised couches, cups, cushions in rows, and scattered carpets are described; traditional exegesis identifies the cushions as spread rugs and carpets as dispersed rugs, in terms suited to the audience's understanding.
rows.anchor: المصفوفة في التفسير : الطنافس المبسوطة . الزرابي المبثوثة في التفسير : البسط المتفرقة . وإنما خاطبهم على

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When people wondered how believers could ascend the raised couches, God pointed to camels that kneel for loading and riding; the couches likewise lower themselves for a saint to mount.
rows.anchor: المرفوعة المشيدة قالوا : كيف يصعدها المؤمن ؟ فقال : أفلا ينظرون إلى الإبل كيف خلقت ؟ كيف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verses admonish people to infer God's perfect power from His creatures; desert Arabs were directed to the sky, earth, mountains, and camels they knew.
rows.anchor: وإنما أنزلت هذه الآيات على وجه التنبيه ، والاستدلال بالمخلوقات على كمال قدرته - سبحانه . فالقوم كانوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Camels display power and favor through usefulness for riding and loads, offspring, meat, milk, wool, ease of taming, endurance of thirst and heavy burdens, resentment, and response to a driver's song.
rows.anchor: منها : ما في إمكانهم من الانتفاع بظهورها للحمل والركوب ، ثم بنسلها ، ثم بلحمها ولبنها ووبرها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad is commanded to remind people; he is not their controller, and reminding them is the mission entrusted to him.
rows.anchor: أنت مذكر لست عليهم بمصيطر } . لست عليهم بمسلط ؛ فذكر - يا محمد - بما أمرناك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whoever turns away from faith and disbelieves will be punished with everlasting residence in the Fire.
rows.anchor: إلا من تولى عن الإيمان وكفر فيعذبه الله بالخلود في النار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All return to God, who then reckons with them and recompenses them for good and evil.
rows.anchor: إيابهم ثم إن علينا حسابهم } . إن إلينا رجوعهم ، ثم نجازيهم على الخير والشر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hearing the basmala brings either sobriety, when heard through knowledge and clear proof, or effacement, when heard through direct recognition and bewilderment before God's dominion.
rows.anchor: إما صحوا لمن سمعها بشاهد العلم فيستبصر بواضح برهانه ، أو محوا لمن سمعها بشاهد المعرفة لأنه يتحير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The opening verses were among the first revelations to the Chosen One, when Gabriel came to him in the air and commanded him to read.
rows.anchor: هذه السورة من أول ما نزل على المصطفى لما تعرض له جبريل في الهواء ، ونزل عليه فقال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All other people are seekers, but Muhammad was the one sought and chosen.
rows.anchor: فالناس كلهم مريدون - وهو كان مرادا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad answered twice that he was not a reader, then Gabriel instructed him to read as he was told.
rows.anchor: ما أنا بقارئ ، فقال له : اقرأ ، فقال : ما أنا بقارئ ، فقال له :

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Who created” means that God created people as they are.
rows.anchor: أي خلقهم على ما هم به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAlaq is the plural of ʿalaqa, like shajar and shajara; a ʿalaqa is congealed blood, and when it flows it is shed blood.
rows.anchor: العلق جمع علقة ؛ كشجر وشجرة . . ( والعلقة الدم الجامد فإذا جرى فهو المسفوح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-akram means generous, or the most generous of every generous one.
rows.anchor: الأكرم ( : أي الكريم . ويقال : الأكرم من كل كريم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God taught people what they did not know, including both necessary and acquired knowledge.
rows.anchor: علمهم ما لم يعلموا : الضروري ، والكسبي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person transgresses when he sees himself as self-sufficient and becomes blind to his need; if he witnesses his need rather than admiring himself, he does not transgress.
rows.anchor: فإذا لم يكن معجبا بنفسه ، وكان مشاهدا لمحل افتقاره - لم يكن طاغيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The return to the Lord is the return on Judgment Day.
rows.anchor: إن إلى ربك الرجعى } . أي : الرجوع يوم القيامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rebuke of the one who forbids a servant from praying implies that it would have been better for him not to do so.
rows.anchor: ينهى عبدا إذا صلى } . أليس لو لم يفعل هذا كان خيرا له ؟ ففي الآية هذا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rhetorical question asks whether it would not be better if the worshipper were guided or commanded piety.
rows.anchor: أرأيت إن كان على الهدى أو أمر بالتقوى } . لكان خيرا له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The denier has denied the religion and turned away from guidance.
rows.anchor: أرءيت إن كذب وتولى } . كذب بالدين . وتولى عن الهداية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The warning that God sees is a call to vigilance; one who has not attained vigilance cannot advance to direct witnessing.
rows.anchor: ألم يعلم بأن الله يرى } . أي : ما الذي يستحقه من هذه صفته ؟ والتخويف برؤية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: To seize someone by the forelock means to take the hair at the front of the head in humiliation and blacken his face.
rows.anchor: نأخذن بناصيته ( وهي شعر مقدم الرأس ) أخذ إذلال . ومعناه لنسودن وجهه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “A lying, sinful forelock” is grammatically an apposition to the forelock by which God threatens to seize him.
rows.anchor: وقوله : { ناصية كاذبة خاطئة } بدل من قوله : { لنسفعا بالناصية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Let him summon his council; God will summon the Zabaniya and command them to destroy him.
rows.anchor: فليدع أهل ناديه وأهل مجلسه ، وسندعو الزبانية ونأمرهم بإهلاكه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The servant approaches the witnessing of Lordship with his heart while remaining on the ground of servanthood with his self; alternatively, prostrate bodily and draw near through the secret.
rows.anchor: اقترب من شهود الربوبية بقلبك ، وقف على بساط العبودية بنفسك . ويقال : فاسجد بنفسك ، واقترب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The basmala awakens scholars to consider proofs and intoxicates knowers who encounter direct manifestations; the former see clearly, while the latter are bewildered by divine majesty.
rows.anchor: بسم الله ' كلمة نحضر قلوب العلماء لتأمل الشواهد ، وتسكر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Night of Decree is a night when mercy is decreed for God's friends, worshippers discover their own worth, and knowers witness the worth of the One they worship; these are very different kinds of “worth.”
rows.anchor: في ليلة قدر فيها الرحمة لأوليائه ، في ليلة يجد فيها العابدون قدر نفوسهم ، ويشهد فيها العارفون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question “What will make you know?” magnifies the greatness of that night.
rows.anchor: أدراك ما ليلة القدر } . استفهام على جهة التفخيم لشأن تلك الليلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months that contain no Night of Decree.
rows.anchor: ليلة القدر خير من ألف شهر } . أي : هي خير من ألف شهر ليست فيها ليلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For the beloved, the short night passes in intimate conversation; a poem compares it to meeting a full moon with a full moon, ending before dawn as a new bride.
rows.anchor: هي ليلة قصيرة على الأحباب لأنهم فيها في مسامرة وخطاب . . كما قيل : يا ليلة من

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One interpretation identifies the Spirit descending with the angels as Gabriel.
rows.anchor: والروح فيها } : قيل جبريل

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another interpretation identifies the Spirit as a great angel.
rows.anchor: وقيل : ملك عظيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “By permission of their Lord” means by their Lord's command.
rows.anchor: بإذن ربهم } : أي بأمر ربهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “From every command, peace” means that with each assigned mission the angels bring God's greeting of peace to His friends.
rows.anchor: من كل أمر سلام } : أي مع كل مأمور منهم سلامي على أوليائي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The night continues until dawn breaks.
rows.anchor: حتى مطلع الفجر } : أي هي باقية إلى أن يطلع الفجر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The majestic basmala is a means through which sinners seek forgiveness and restoration, the obedient reach God and receive support, the learned gain insight, and the gnostics draw near.
rows.anchor: بسم الله ' اسم عزيز تتصل إليه المذنبون فغفر لهم وجبرهم : وتوسل إليه المطيعون فوصلهم ونصرهم .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The disbelievers would not cease their state of disbelief until the proof, Muhammad, came; scripture had led them to affirm him, but when he was sent they envied and rejected him.
rows.anchor: منفكين ) : منتهين عن كفرهم حتى تأتيهم البينة : وهي رسول الله ، أي لم يزالوا مجتمعين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The messenger from God recites purified scrolls preserved from alteration by the disbelievers.
rows.anchor: أي حتى يأتيهم رسول من الله يقرأ كتبا مطهرة عن تبديل الكفار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The upright books are straight and contain no crookedness.
rows.anchor: فيها كتب قيمة } : مستوية ليس فيها اعوجاج

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people who received Scripture divided only after the proof came, meaning the Quran.
rows.anchor: وما تفرق الذين أوتوا الكتاب إلا من بعد ما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sincere worship means affirming God's oneness without associating anything with Him; one definition makes every movement and stillness for God, another purifies action from defect.
rows.anchor: مخلصين له الدين } أي موحدين لا يشركون بالله شيئا ؛ فالإخلاص ألا يكون شيء من حركاتك وسكناتك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hanif means inclining toward truth and turning away from falsehood.
rows.anchor: حنفاء ) : مائلين إلى الحق ، عادلين عن الباطل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The “upright religion” means the upright religious community or the upright sacred law.
rows.anchor: وذلك دين القيمة } : أي دين الملة القيمة ، والأمة القيمة ، والشريعة القيمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who disbelieve remain in Hell eternally; al-bariyya means creation.
rows.anchor: خالدين فيها } : مقيمين : { البرية } : الخليقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Believers who do good are the best of creation, which indicates that they are superior to the angels.
rows.anchor: وعملوا الصالحات أولئك هم خير البرية } . أي : خير الخلق ، وهذا يدل على أنهم أفضل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The gardens of Eden are the reward given in the next life for obedience, with rivers flowing beneath their trees.
rows.anchor: أي ثوابهم في الآخرة على طاعاتهم . { تجرى من تحتها الأنهار } : أي : من تحت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is pleased with them and they with Him; every claim they had is fulfilled for them.
rows.anchor: الله عنهم ورضوا عنه } . فلم تبق لهم مطالبة إلا حققها لهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “That is for whoever fears his Lord” refers to fearing Him in this world.
rows.anchor: ربه } . أي : خافه في الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Contentment is the heart's gladness with the bitterness of destiny, or the heart's stillness under the unfolding of God's decree.
rows.anchor: والرضا سرور القلب بمر القضا . ويقال : هو سكون القلب تحت جريان الحكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Reflecting on the basmala makes the inner secrets flourish in intimacy and thoughts ripen in lights of certainty; it witnesses to God's majesty and exceeds what speech can enumerate.
rows.anchor: بسم الله ' كلمة من تأملها بمعانيها ووقف على ما أودع فيها رتعت أسراره في رياض من الأنس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earth's burdens that emerge are its dead, treasures, and buried things.
rows.anchor: إذا زلزلت الأرض زلزالها وأخرجت الأرض أثقالها } . أي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The person asking what is wrong with the earth is the disbeliever who does not believe in resurrection.
rows.anchor: وقال الإنسان ما لها } . يعني الكافر الذي لا يؤمن بها أي بالبعث

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On that day the earth will report its news.
rows.anchor: يومئذ تحدث أخبارها } . يومئذ تخبر الأرض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earth speaks because God has commanded it to do so.
rows.anchor: بأن ربك أوحى لها } . أي : إنما تفعل ذلك بأمر الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People depart in separate groups on that day in order to be shown their deeds and reckoned.
rows.anchor: أشتاتا } : متفرقين . { ليروا أعمالهم } ليحاسبوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Everyone who does an atom's weight of good or evil sees it and bears its consequence.
rows.anchor: فمن يعمل مثقال ذرة خيرا يره ومن يعمل مثقال ذرة شرا يره } . فيقاسي عناءه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The basmala is a name that enriches whoever obeys it and misleads and blinds whoever opposes it; agreement raises a person, opposition casts him into trial.
rows.anchor: بسم الله ' اسم غني من أطاعه أغناه ، ومن خالفه أضله وأعماه . اسم عزيز من وافقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Have you not seen” asks whether knowledge of what God did to the People of the Elephant reached Muhammad through revelation.
rows.anchor: ألم تر كيف فعل ربك بأصحاب الفيل ) ^ ألم ينته إليك فيما أنزل عليك علم ما فعل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The story shows that God specially protected the Ancient House.
rows.anchor: وفي قصة أصحاب الفيل دلالة على تخصيص الله البيت العتيق بالحفظ والكلاءة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraha, a Christian king of Yemen, built a church at Sana'a and planned to destroy the Kaaba so that pilgrimage would be redirected to his church.
rows.anchor: وذلك أن أبرهة - ملك اليمن - كان نصرانيا ، وبنى بيعة لهم بصنعاء . وأراد هدم الكعبة

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: An alternative account says Arabs visiting the land of the Negus left a fire burning; wind carried it to the church and burned it, prompting Abraha to march on the Kaaba.
rows.anchor: وقيل : نزل جماعة من العرب ببلاد النجاشي ، وأوقدوا نارا لحاجة لهم ، ثم تغافلوا عنها ولم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When Abraha's army took two hundred of ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib's camels, he went to Abraha to ask for their return; he insisted that he came for his camels, not to negotiate about the sanctuary.
rows.anchor: فلما قرب من مكة أصاب مائتي جمل لعبد المطلب ، فلما أخبر بذلك ركب إليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib returned to Quraysh and prayed while holding the Kaaba's door ring that God protect His sanctuary from the cross and its forces.
rows.anchor: فعاد عبد المطلب إلى قريش ، وأخبرهم بما حدث ، ثم قام وأخذ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God sent green birds from the sea with long necks, each bearing a stone in its beak and two in its claws; their stones rained down and killed the army.
rows.anchor: فأرسل الله عليهم طيرا أخضر من جهة البحر طوال الأعناق ، في

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Accounts differ on the stones' size: some place them between a lentil and chickpea, others between a chickpea and pistachio; each bore its target's name, and some were black-striped.
rows.anchor: قيل : الحجرة منها فوق العدس دون الحمص . وقيل : فوق الحمص دون الفستق ، مكتوب على

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Reports differ on whether the invading army had eight elephants or one, and whether the event was forty or twenty-three years before the Prophet's birth; another report says he was born in the Year of the Elephant.
rows.anchor: وقيل : كان الفيل ثمانية ؛ وقيل : كان فيلا واحدا . وقيل : رواية : إنه كان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their plot was rendered void.
rows.anchor: تضليل } . أي : مكرهم في إبطال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ababil means birds assembled in groups, whether gathered or dispersed.
rows.anchor: وأرسل عليهم طيرا أبابيل } . { أبابيل } : مجمعة ومتفرقة

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Sijjil is glossed in Persian as stone or clay, meaning clay baked like brick.
rows.anchor: ترميهم بحجارة من سجيل } . قيل بالفارسية : سنكل أو كل - أي طين طبخ بالنار كالآجر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Eaten straw” means the ends of crops before ripening, while “eaten” refers to their fruit having been consumed.
rows.anchor: فجعلهم كعصف مأكول } . { كعصف } : كأطراف الزرع قبل أن يدرك . ( مأكول )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib was an unbeliever, he sincerely sought God's protection for the House; God did not disappoint him, so a sincere believer's prayer will not be rejected.
rows.anchor: ويقال : إذا كان عبد المطلب - وهو كافر - أخلص في التجائه إلى الله في استدفاع البلاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another lesson is that God answered because ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib asked for the House, not for himself; what is for God is never lost.
rows.anchor: ويقال : إنما أجيب لأنه لم يسأل لنفسه ، وإنما لأجل البيت . . . وما كان لله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The basmala's bāʾ is the monotheists' secret of release from counting temporal events and created things; it signals reliance on God in ease and hardship.
rows.anchor: بسم : الباء في ' بسم ' سر الموحدين عن حسبان الحدثان ، وعن كل شيء مما لم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sīn signifies their stillness beneath whatever appears from the unseen, while maintaining proper etiquette.
rows.anchor: والسين تشير إلى سكونهم في جميع أحوالهم تحت جريان ما يبدو من الغيب بشرط مراعاة الأدب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mīm signifies God's favor in enabling them to know Him and devote themselves to obedience.
rows.anchor: والميم تشير إلى منة الله عليهم بالتوفيق لما تحققوا به من معرفته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Īlāf is the verbal noun of aʾlafa, to make someone accustomed; the Quraysh had two provisioning journeys, to Syria in summer and Yemen in winter.
rows.anchor: وكانت لهم رحلتان للامتيار : رحلة إلى الشام في القيظ ، ورحلة إلى اليمن في الشتاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God destroyed the enemy so Quraysh could continue their accustomed summer and winter journeys.
rows.anchor: والمعنى : أنعم الله عليهم بإهلاك عدوهم ليؤلفهم رحلتيهم

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One syntactic reading links “Let them worship the Lord of this House” to “for the security of Quraysh,” presenting worship as the greater favor.
rows.anchor: البيت } { لإيلاف قريش } كأنه أعظم المنة عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They should worship God in response to His favor of feeding them when hungry.
rows.anchor: أطعمهم من جوع } . فليعبدوه لما أنعم به عليهم

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One explanation connects the feeding with famine that afflicted them after the Prophet prayed against them.
rows.anchor: أطعمهم من جوع } بعد ما أصابهم من القحط حينما دعا عليهم الرسول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God gave them security from fear by making the sanctuary safe and protecting them from enemies.
rows.anchor: من خوف } . حين جعل الحرم آمنا ، وأجارهم من عدوهم

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: It is also said God spared them both journeys by bringing provisions to them from Syria and Yemen.
rows.anchor: ويقال : أنعم عليهم بأن كفاهم الرحلتين بجلب الناس الميرة إليهم من الشام ومن اليمن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Food and safety let them devote themselves to worship, since people whose affairs are insecure lack the strength and heart for worship.
rows.anchor: ووجه المنة في الإطعام والأمان هو أن يتفرغوا إلى عبادة الله ؛ فإن من لم يكن مكفي الأمور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an lists fear before the other kinds of trial.
rows.anchor: فقدم الخوف على جميع أنواع البلاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hearing the basmala nourishes lovers' spirits, lights the finders' secrets, heals repentant hearts, tests the poor, and remedies the needy.
rows.anchor: بسم الله ' كلمة سماعها غذاء أرواح المحبين ، ضياء أسرار الواجدين ، شفاء قلوب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse rebukes and expresses wonder at disbelievers' abuse of orphans; religion here includes accounting and recompense.
rows.anchor: يكذب بالدين } . نزلت الآية على جهة التوبيخ ، والتعجب من شأن تظلم اليتيم من الكفار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The orphan-pusher shoves him harshly and may also be denying him his rights.
rows.anchor: يدع اليتيم } . يدفعه بجفوة ، ويقال : يدفعه عن حقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He does not urge feeding the poor because he is miserly and tight-fisted.
rows.anchor: ولا يحض على طعام المسكين } . أي : لا يحث على إطعام المسكين ، وإنما يدع اليتيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The text quotes the saying that mercy is removed only from the heart of a wretched person.
rows.anchor: ولا تنزع الرحمة إلا من قلب شقي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The basmala is a name whose dignity ennobles the servant, raises those favored by it, and humiliates its enemies through punishment.
rows.anchor: اسم عزيز أعز من شاء بأفضاله وإقباله ، وأذل أعداءه بسلاسله وأغلاله ، والتخليد في جحيمه وأنكاله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-kawthar means abundant plenty.
rows.anchor: { الكوثر } : أي الخبر الكثير . ويقال : هو نهر في الجنة

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: One view identifies al-Kawthar as a river in Paradise.
rows.anchor: ويقال : هو نهر في الجنة

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: One view identifies al-Kawthar as prophethood and scripture.
rows.anchor: ويقال : النبوة والكتاب

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One view identifies al-Kawthar as the easing of the religious law.
rows.anchor: وقيل : تخفيف الشريعة

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: One view identifies al-Kawthar as the large number of Muhammad's community.
rows.anchor: ويقال : كثرة أمته

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: One view identifies al-Kawthar as his companions and followers.
rows.anchor: ويقال : الأصحاب والأشياع

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: One view identifies al-Kawthar as a light in Muhammad's heart.
rows.anchor: ويقال : نور في قلبه

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: One view identifies al-Kawthar as Muhammad's knowledge of God's lordship.
rows.anchor: ويقال : معرفته بربوبيته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command is to perform the Eid prayer and sacrifice the offering.
rows.anchor: فصل لربك وانحر } . أي صل صلاة العيد { وانحر } النسك

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: The command combines bodily worship through prayer and financial worship through sacrifice.
rows.anchor: ويقال : جمع له في الأمر بين : العبادة البدنية ، والمالية

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another interpretation of nahr is to face the qibla with one's chest.
rows.anchor: ويقال ( وانحر ) أي استقبل القبلة بنحرك

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another interpretation is to raise one's hands to the neck in prayer.
rows.anchor: أو ارفع يديك في صلاتك إلى نحرك

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another interpretation is to place the right hand over the left beneath the neck in prayer.
rows.anchor: ويقال : ضع يمينك على يسارك في الصلاة واجعلها تحت نحرك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad's hater is the one cut off: he will not be remembered favorably and has no share of good.
rows.anchor: إن شانئك هو الأبتر } . أي : لا يذكر بخير ، منقطع عنه كل خير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Belief in the basmala protects one from the loss of blessings and brings happiness and enduring dominion in this world and the next.
rows.anchor: بسم الله ' كلمة من آمن بها أمن من زوال النعمى ، وحظي بنعيم الدنيا والعقبى وسعد سعادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad refuses to worship the disbelievers' idols.
rows.anchor: أعبد ما تعبدون } . من أصنامكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In “what I worship,” mā means “whom I worship.”
rows.anchor: أعبد } . ( ما ) أعبد أي ( من ) أعبد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad is not a worshipper of what the disbelievers worship in their time.
rows.anchor: ولا أنا عابد ما عبدتم } . في زمانكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The repeated denial that they worship what Muhammad worships emphasizes the point.
rows.anchor: أعبد } . كرر اللفظ على جهة التأكيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Each party receives recompense for its religion: yours is your recompense and mine is mine.
rows.anchor: دين } . أي : لكم جزاؤكم على دينكم ، ولي الجزاء على ديني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Servanthood is fulfilling God's command in its prescribed manner, measure, and time.
rows.anchor: والعبودية القيام بأمره على الوجه الذي به أمر ، وبالقدر الذي به أمر ، وفي الوقت الذي فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One account defines truthful servanthood as surrendering choice and remaining still beneath destiny without distress.
rows.anchor: ويقال : صدق العبودية في ترك الاختيار ، ويظهر ذلك في السكون تحت تصاريف الأقدار من غير انكسار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another account defines servanthood as the heart's complete absence of resistance to however its Master directs it.
rows.anchor: ويقال : العبودية انتفاء الكراهية بكل وجه من القلب كيفما صرفك مولاك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The basmala is a gracious name that sees yet veils, knows and forbears, praises without exposing, and pardons repeated sins.
rows.anchor: بسم الله ' اسم كريم يبصر ويستر ، ويعلم ويحلم ويمدح ولا يفضح ، ويعفو عن جميع ما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Victory is triumph over an enemy, and the conquest is the conquest of Mecca.
rows.anchor: نصر الله والفتح } . النصر الظفر بالعدو

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People enter God's religion in successive groups.
rows.anchor: دين الله أفواجا } . يسلمون جماعات جماعات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command to glorify with praise means to praise God abundantly, pray to Him, and declare His holiness.
rows.anchor: فسبح بحمد ربك واستغفره } . أكثر حمد ربك ، وصل له ، وقدسه

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: One interpretation says to pray in gratitude for this blessing.
rows.anchor: ويقال : صل شكرا لهذه النعمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Seeking forgiveness means asking God to forgive.
rows.anchor: واستغفره } وسل مغفرته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is ever accepting of repentance, accepting whoever repents.
rows.anchor: إنه كان توابا } . لمن تاب ؛ فإنه يقبل توبته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Spiritually, God's victory consists in annihilating the Prophet from himself, removing human qualities, and purifying him of psychic turbidity.
rows.anchor: ويقال : نصرة الله - سبحانه - له بأن أفناه عن نفسه ، وأبعد عنه أحكام البشرية ،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The spiritual conquest raises him to nearness, clothes him in union, reveals hidden divine secrets, and teaches knowledge for which all creatures yearn.
rows.anchor: وأما ( الفتح ) : فهو أن رقاه إلى محل الدنو ، واستخلصه بخصائص الزلفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For sinners the basmala repairs their deeds and fulfills hopes; for knowers it makes their states seem small, strips them away, and grants union after their annihilation.
rows.anchor: بسم الله ' كلمة جبارة للمذنبين ، تجبر أعمالهم ، وتحقق آمالهم ، وهي للعارفين تصغر في

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abu Lahab's hands were ruined and he himself ruined.
rows.anchor: لهب وتب } . أي : خسرت يداه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His wealth and vile earnings did not benefit him at all.
rows.anchor: ما أغنى عنه ماله ولا كسبه الخبيث - شيئا

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: An alternative interpretation of “what he earned” is his child.
rows.anchor: وقيل : { ما كسب } : ولده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abu Lahab is bound to the blazing fire with no escape, and his wife will burn with him.
rows.anchor: سيصلى نارا ذات لهب وامرأته حمالة الحطب } . يلزمها إذا دخلها ؛ فلا براح له منها .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A masad is something twisted into a cord; Abu Lahab's wife carried thorns and scattered them on the Prophet's road.
rows.anchor: جيدها حبل من مسد } . ( مسد ) شيء مفتول ، وكانت تحمل الشوك وتنقله وتبثه في

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Woe to anyone who fails to know Muhammad's worth: wealth cannot help his opponent against the one God has exalted, whose end and his wife's is disgrace.
rows.anchor: ويقال : سحقا لمن لا يعرف قدرك - يا محمد . وبعدا لمن لم يشهد ما خصصناك به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The basmala's recognition unfolds through increasingly inward levels: the tongue remembers it, the heart knows it, the spirit loves it, and the secret witnesses it; not all who seek or find it remain with it.
rows.anchor: بسم الله ' كلمة عزيزة عز لسان ذكرها ، وأعز منه قلب عرفها وأعز من هذا روح أحبها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When the polytheists asked Muhammad to describe their Lord, God revealed “Say: He is God, One.”
rows.anchor: أنسب لنا ربك : أنزل الله تعالى : { قل هو الله أحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The word huwa points to the one about whom they asked: He is Allah.
rows.anchor: فمعنى ( هو ) أي : الذي سألتم عنه ( هو ) الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A grammatical reading makes huwa the subject, Allah its first predicate, and ahad a second predicate, like saying “this is sweet-sour.”
rows.anchor: خبر ثان كقولهم : هذا حلو حامض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-samad can mean the master to whom needs and requests are directed, or the one perfect in deserving praise.
rows.anchor: الصمد } : السيد الذي يصمد إليه الحوائج ، ويقصد إليه في المطالب . ويقال : الكامل في

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qushayri favors the explanation “without a cavity” as a confirmation that God is one and indivisible in His essence.
rows.anchor: تحقيق قول من قال : إنه الذي لا جوف له إلى أنه واحد لا ( . . .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is neither parent nor child.
rows.anchor: لم يلد ولم يولد } . ليس بوالد ولا مولود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse means that no one is His equal; ahad derives from wahd, and God's oneness excludes a partner, likeness, or division.
rows.anchor: أصله وحد ، ووحد وواحد بمعنى ، وكونه واحدا : أنه لا قسيم له ولا شبيه له ولا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Each part of the surah explains the one before it: He is God, the One, the Self-Sufficient, without offspring or origin, with no equal.
rows.anchor: السورة بعضها تفسير لبعض ؛ من هو الله ؟ هو الله . من الله ؟ الأحد ، من

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One mystical reading says “He” unveils the secrets, “Allah” the spirits, and “One” the hearts.
rows.anchor: ويقال : كاشف الأسرار بقوله : ( هو ) . وكاشف الأرواح بقوله : ( الله ) وكاشف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another reading assigns “He” to the lovers, “Allah” to monotheists, “One” to knowers, “al-Samad” to scholars, and the next phrase to rational people.
rows.anchor: ويقال : كاشف الوالهين بقوله : ( هو ) ، والموحدين بقوله : ( الله ) والعارفين بقوله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When people spoke ill of God, the Prophet was commanded to answer them; when they spoke ill of the Prophet, God answered on his behalf.
rows.anchor: بسطوا لسان الذم في الله أمر نبينا بأن يرد عليهم فقال : { قل هو الله أحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God defends the Prophet in 68:1–2 and 53:1–2 by declaring him neither mad nor astray.
rows.anchor: والنجم إذا هوى ما ضل صاحبكم وما غوى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The most elect are addressed with “He”; those below them receive the fuller declarations “Allah,” “One,” and “al-Samad.”
rows.anchor: ويقال : خاطب الذين هم خاص الخواص بقوله : ( هو ) فاستقلوا ، ثم زاد لمن نزل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Creatures have access to al-Samad only as a name and attribute, not as its reality.
rows.anchor: ويقال : الصمد الذي ليس عند الخلق منه إلا الاسم والصفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's self-sufficiency is beyond the reach of creatures' knowledge, sight, and spiritual recognition.
rows.anchor: ويقال : الصمد الذي تقدس عن إحاطة علم المخلوق به وعن إدراك بصرهم له ، وعن إشراف معارفهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: By His self-sufficiency, God is beyond the grasp of spiritual knowers and intellects.
rows.anchor: تقدس بصمديته عن وقوف المعارف عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When the basmala manifests to the heart through beauty it revives it; when it manifests through majesty it annihilates it, and the servant alternates between subsistence and annihilation, effacement and affirmation, presence and absence.
rows.anchor: بسم الله ' اسم عزيز إذا تجلى لقلب فإن لاطفه بجماله أحياه ، وإن كاشفه بجلاله أباده وأفناه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: To seek refuge means to abstain from harm and take protection in God.
rows.anchor: قل أعوذ برب الفلق } . أي امتنع واعتصم برب الفلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-falaq may mean dawn.
rows.anchor: والفلق الصبح

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One interpretation makes al-falaq all creatures.
rows.anchor: ويقال : هو الخلق كلهم

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another interpretation makes al-falaq a valley in Hell.
rows.anchor: وقيل الفلق واد في جهنم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “The evil of what He created” means every kind of evil.
rows.anchor: من شر ما خلق } . أي من الشرور كلها

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One interpretation of the darkening one is night when it enters.
rows.anchor: ومن شر غاسق إذا وقب } . قيل : الليل إذا دخل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet took ʿAisha's hand, pointed to the moon, and told her to seek God's protection from its evil, for it is the darkening one when it enters.
rows.anchor: وفي خبر ، أنه أخذ بيد عائشة ونظر إلى القمر فقال : ( يا عائشة ، تعوذي بالله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The blowers in knots are sorceresses who blow on knotted thread during incantations and delude people into believing they can cause harm.
rows.anchor: العقد } . وهن السواحر اللواتي ينفخن في عقد الخيط ( عند الرقية ) ويوهمن إدخال الضرر بذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Envy is an evil character trait.
rows.anchor: ومن شر حاسد إذا حسد } . والحسد شر الأخلاق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The surah teaches that one should ask God to fend off evils.
rows.anchor: وفي السورة تعليم استدفاع الشرور من الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sound trust in God is sound realization of Him; God only grants reliance to one whose condition He knows He will suffice.
rows.anchor: ومن صح توكله على الله فهو الذي صح تحققه بالله ، فإذا توكل لم يوفقه الله للتوكل إلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If the servant stops relying on personal plans, power, understanding, and insight to escape affliction, the heart rests from planning and soon reaches contentment whether its wish is fulfilled or not.
rows.anchor: وإن العبد به حاجة إلى دفع البلاء عنه - فإن أخذ في التحرز من تدبيره وحوله وقوته ،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The servant continues to seek refuge outwardly while inwardly submitting and consenting to God's decree.
rows.anchor: وعند ذلك الملك الأعظم ، فهو بظاهره لا يفتر عن الاستعاذه ، وبقلبه لا يخلو من التسليم والرضا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The basmala exceeds the grasp of minds, sciences, recognition, and understanding: God is known and seen, but comprehensive knowledge, perception, or description of Him is impossible.
rows.anchor: بسم الله ' الذي قصرت عنه العقول فوقفت ، وعجزت العلوم فتحيرت ، وتقاصرت المعارف فخجلت ، وانقطعت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Lord of people is their creator and master.
rows.anchor: قل أعوذ برب الناس } . أعتصم برب الناس خالقهم وسيدهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The King of people is the one who owns them all.
rows.anchor: ملك الناس } . أي مالكهم جميعهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The God of people is the one able to create them.
rows.anchor: إله الناس } . القادر على إيجادهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Waswas is inner discourse resembling a quiet voice; it may also refer to whispering that occurs between jinn and people.
rows.anchor: من شر الوسواس الخناس } . من حديث النفس بما هو كالصوت الخفي . ويقال : من شر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Khannas is the one who disappears and retreats from the remembrance of God; it is an attribute of Satan.
rows.anchor: والخناس ) الذي يغيب ويخنس عن ذكر الله . وهو من أوصاف الشيطان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The word “people” can include jinn and humans: the Qur'an calls jinn a group and calls jinn “men.”
rows.anchor: قيل : ( الناس ) يقع لفظها على الجن والإنس جميعا - كما قال تعالى : { وإذ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On that reading, refuge is from Satan whispering in people's chests and from Satan-like forces that dominate people; the human self also has impulses, close to Satan's whispers.
rows.anchor: فعلى هذا استعاذ من الشيطان الذي يوسوس في صدور الناس ، والشيطان الذي له تسلط على الناس كالوسواس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Any call to appetite, religious error, sin, or blameworthy traits arises from whispers and the soul's impulses.
rows.anchor: إذ إن يدعو إلى متابعة الشهوة أو الضلالة في الدين أو إلى ارتكاب المعصية ، أو إلى الخصال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Knowledge distinguishes divine inspiration and sound thoughts from whisperings.
rows.anchor: وبالعلم يميز الإلهام وبين الخواطر الصحيحة وبين الوساوس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When Satan's first invitation to a forbidden act is resisted, he switches to another sin, since his sole aim is to keep inviting people, though his suggestions vary.
rows.anchor: ومما تجب معرفته ) أن الشيطان إذا دعا إلى محظور فإن خالفته يدع ذلك ( ثم ) يدعوك
